Enumeration by Transfer Matrix

Abstract

We apply the transfer matrix method to the enumeration of finite topologies.

1. Introduction

The transfer matrix method converts the counting problem into a product of sparse matrices.

2. The transfer matrix

Each layer contributes one matrix factor.

3. Complexity

The method is exponential but practical to n = 18.

4. Conclusions

Discussion and conclusions: transfer matrices extend the known range by two terms.

References

  1. P. Alexandroff. Diskrete Räume. Mat. Sbornik, 2:501-519, 1937.
  2. R. Stanley. On the number of open sets of finite topologies. J. Combin. Theory, 10(1):74-79, 1971. doi:10.1016/S0021-9800(71)80011-5
  3. M. Erne. Struktur- und Anzahlformeln fur Topologien auf endlichen Mengen. Manuscripta Math., 11:221-259, 1974.
